visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width rotating promo banner with a photo background per slide, prev/next arrows, dot pagination and autoplay (pauses on hover/focus)
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width rotating banner with photo background per slide, white text on the left, prev/next arrows and dot pagination. Photo background belongs to the block.

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide. Cell 1: background image (only the image). Cell 2: heading (title), subtitle paragraph, CTA link, optional coupon as inline code (`PORTOPLUS`, rendered with a Copiar button), fine-print paragraphs after the CTA/coupon become the disclaimer
contentPattern.blockContent: 3 rotating promo slides with background photo, title, subtitle, CTA or coupon, disclaimer
contentPattern.source: One row per slide: cell 1 background image (source img is the 430x764 mobile crop; desktop source in <picture><source>), cell 2 H1 title, subtitle paragraph (slide 1/3 source H2, slide 2 second H1 -> keep only first as heading, subtitle as paragraph), CTA link, coupon text 'Cupom: PORTOPLUS' (copy-to-clipboard button becomes text/code), fine-print disclaimer paragraph.

usage: Top-of-page promotional hero with 1 to N rotating campaigns. A single row renders a static banner without controls.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any hero campaign carousel with background photography. For a static hero without rotation, use hero.
